notes: THIS IS A DATED SNAPSHOT, NOT LIVE DATA. It exists so the module produces an auditable number offline and with no API keys. Every quote sourced from it is tagged quality=baseline and its confidence decays with age.
Configure at least one live provider before quoting a residual value to a customer. See docs/market-data.md for the options and what each costs.
Metals are quoted in USD per metric tonne, the market convention. The FX layer converts to the caller's currency.
Battery-grade salts (nickel/cobalt sulphate, lithium carbonate) trade against assessed indices, not exchanges. The levels here are representative mid-cycle values, not assessments.

nickel_metal.reference: LME nickel cash settlement, representative level

lithium_carbonate.reference: Battery-grade Li2CO3 99.5%, CIF Asia representative level

lithium_hydroxide.reference: Battery-grade LiOH.H2O, CIF Asia representative level

copper_metal.reference: LME copper grade A cash settlement, representative level

aluminium_metal.reference: LME aluminium high grade cash settlement, representative level

lead_metal.reference: LME lead cash settlement, representative level

graphite_flake.reference: Natural flake graphite 94-95% C, FOB China representative level

notes: Reference prices for whole battery systems, used by the reuse and second-life pathways rather than the recycling pathway.
new_pack_price is the BloombergNEF-style volume-weighted average lithium-ion PACK price, the anchor for what a replacement unit is worth new.
turnkey_bess_price is a fully installed 4-hour stationary system, the product a repurposed pack competes against.
oem_replacement_pack_price is the retail over-the-counter price of a new OEM traction pack, which is far above the OEM's own cost and sets the ceiling for a used replacement pack.

new_pack_price.reference: Volume-weighted average Li-ion pack price, BNEF-style annual survey basis

turnkey_bess_price.reference: Fully installed 4-hour utility-scale BESS, representative level

oem_replacement_pack_price.reference: Retail OEM EV replacement pack, excluding labour; varies widely by model

lfp_pack_price.reference: LFP pack price, typically 12-18% below the blended average

fx_fallback.notes: EUR-based reference rates used only when the ECB feed is unreachable. Units are foreign currency per 1 EUR.
